alternatives_rejected.why: The emailservice-scoped query shows only latency-50 and latency-90 deviations. No cpu or memory metric reached significance (E2), which matches a delay fault, not resource exhaustion.

Its latency-90 deviation (z=524) is well below emailservice's (z=903) (E1). shippingservice also does not appear in any of the worst ~5s failing trace paths, which all pass through emailservice (E3, E5).
Its latency deviation (z=352) is the smallest of the three (E1). It sits upstream of emailservice in the failing traces (E3), so its slowness fits waiting on slow email calls.

proposed_fix.description: Check emailservice pods and network for injected latency, such as tc/netem rules or chaos experiments, and remove them. Add a client-side timeout and async/fire-and-forget email sending in checkoutservice so email delay no longer blocks checkout. Watch emailservice latency-90 return to baseline.
